pre_condition: work_dir contains a valid phases.json file at the expected path; proj_dir is an existing directory; required_source_files, if not None, is a non-empty sequence of file paths relative to proj_dir; submodules, if not None, is a non-empty sequence of subdirectory names within proj_dir; one_phase is a boolean
post_condition: Returns True if any of the following structural modifications were applied to phases.json: (1) required source files were forcibly inserted into phases, (2) source files were removed due to submodule filtering, (3) source files were deduplicated so that each file is assigned to exactly one phase, (4) empty phases were removed or phases were renumbered, or (5) all phases were collapsed into a single phase when one_phase is True. Returns False if none of these modifications occurred. On return, the phases.json file at the expected path under work_dir reflects the final state after all post-processing steps: every source file path appears in at most one phase's module, empty phases are absent, phase numbering is contiguous starting from 1, and module descriptions for affected modules are updated.
